senses.gloss:
भैषज भैषज, अस्, m. (fr. भेषज), a
sort of quail, Perdix Chinensis; (आस्), m. pl. of the
patronymic Bhaiṣajya below; (अम्), n. a drug,
medicine, medicament.

भैषज्य, अस्, m. the descendant of a physician;
a patronymic from Bhiṣaj; (अम्), n. the adminis-
tering of medicines and healing applications to the
sick; curativeness, healing efficacy; a particular
ceremony (performed as a remedy for sickness); any
remedy, drug, medicine, medicament.
—भैषज्य-
गुरु-वैदूर्य-प्रभा, f., N. of a Buddhist work.
—भैषज्य-रत्नावली, f., N. of a medical work.
—भैषज्य-राज, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—भैषज्य-समुद्गत, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-
sattva.
भैष्णज, आस्, m. pl. of the following.
भैष्णज्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhiṣṇaja.

भैष्मक भैष्मक, अस्, m. (fr. भीष्मक),
a patronymic; (ई), f. a patronymic of Rukmiṇī.
